name: Super Duper Image Auto Optimizer
author: Shakib R Khan

sections.description:
Super Duper Image Auto Optimizer reduces image sizes on upload (and through a bulk tool) to keep your site fast.

What’s fixed for review
* Uses wp_register_script, wp_enqueue_script, wp_add_inline_script and their style equivalents instead of echoing <script> / <style>.
* All functions, classes, options, and AJAX actions use the sdiao_ / SDIAO_ prefixes.
* Removes WordPress.org directory assets from the plugin ZIP (upload banners/icons to /assets/ in SVN after approval).
* Uninstall removes the sdiao_settings option.

Notes
* The bulk optimizer in this package is a demo endpoint. Replace the stub with your real optimization logic.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Media → Image Auto Optimizer to configure settings and run bulk optimization.
sections.faq:
Does this modify original uploads?

The included hooks demonstrate where you would call your optimizer. Add your own logic to control whether originals are overwritten or separate files are created.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Review compliance: proper enqueues, unique prefixes, uninstall cleanup, and readme contributor fix.
